display_long_description:
The Virtual Reality Oracle is a first-person virtual reality experience of oracular divination at the ancient Greek oracle of Zeus at Dodona c. 465 BCE.  

What was it like to consult the ancient Greek gods? Travel back in time and visit an ancient Greek oracle of Zeus. 

For centuries, ancient Greek men and women visited oracular sanctuaries – sacred sites where they could ask the gods to reveal secrets of the past, present and future.  

In this experience you will:  
- Explore an ancient sacred site. 
- Learn about the lives of ancient Greek men and women. 
- Take part in an oracular ritual for yourself – what would you ask Zeus? 

The Virtual Reality Oracle: An Immersive Experience of the Ancient Greek Oracle at Dodona is a collaboration between academics at the University of Bristol, the University of Bath, and King’s College London. The VR was created in collaboration with Friday Sundae Studios. The project is funded by the UK Arts and Humanities Research Council. For more information, visit our website at www.vroracle.co.uk.
